source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Skipping any dietary modification at all for the client, regardless of what the swallowing assessment findings actually happen to show","B":"Fairly few specific positioning considerations built into how the client is actually fed during meals following the assessment","C":"Encouraging the client to eat as quickly as possible in order to finish each meal in the shortest time achievable","D":"Upright positioning during and after meals, modified food/liquid consistency as recommended, and close supervision during oral intake"}}
source_row.rationale: Aspiration precautions for a client with dysphagia typically include upright positioning during and after meals, modified food/liquid consistency per swallowing evaluation recommendations, and close supervision during oral intake to reduce aspiration risk.
source_row.source_name: AHA/ASA / ASHA — Post-Stroke Aspiration Precaution Guidelines
